card.name: Whose after a preposition, plus names
card.fires_on: The word "whose" right after a preposition such as in, on, under or into, in narrative or historical prose. It also fires on some names and partial names, like Kobe, Chloe or the "obe" in Zenobe.

modes.label: Preposition + whose
modes.description: The word "whose" follows a preposition and begins a relative clause about a person or group.
modes.example: a body of eight statesmen into<< whose>> hands he had committed all his financial affairs

modes.label: Names and name parts
modes.description: A place or personal name, or a piece of one, appears in running text.
modes.example: disaster recovery efforts in<< Kobe>>, Japan and Aceh, Indonesia.
